source: flutter\_translate keeps plural forms as nested keys. From version 4, the forms are the Intl plural names {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} and {5}. Before version 4, they were {6}, {7}, {8} and {9}. The preset adds a derived key {10} for each of these forms, so the {11} check does not report the forms of a used key.
text: flutter\_translate speichert Pluralformen als verschachtelte Schlüssel. Ab Version 4 sind die Formen die Intl-Pluralnamen {0}, {1}, {2}, {3}, {4} und {5}. Vor Version 4 waren es {6}, {7}, {8} und {9}. Das Preset fügt für jede dieser Formen einen abgeleiteten Schlüssel {10} hinzu, sodass die Prüfung {11} die Formen eines verwendeten Schlüssels nicht meldet.
